reading_notes: source5_twin.arms.*.places_pooled.cutoff_err_min_system_minus_true has median 0 and p90 0 only because 103 of 214 places were already cut at issue (error exactly 0). Quote places_split.truth_cut_inside_horizon instead (n=111, median -175.6 min).

exploratory.label: EXPLORATORY, not in the frozen protocol. Model output on reconstructed inputs. Not what happened to people.
exploratory.reading: No FIRMS/AHI disc is added between T and t_S that touches a satellite-burned cell outside the known area at T; the 23-24 March interval holds no detected growth, so this scene has little power to test the 8 h margin.
